lines.en: label halloweenfour15:
if amilust50skip == True:
scene mayakaraoke1
: Hahah! Whoops! Looks like your repeated refusal to {b}FUCK ME{/b} has broken this scene’s continuity! Now, nothing is going to make sense! Restart the fucking game!
lines.zh: 哈哈！哎呀！看来你一次次拒绝{b}操我{/b}，把这场景的连贯性都给搞坏了！现在什么都说不通了！重开这破游戏吧！

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke2
else:
scene mayakaraoke2
: Oh. Hi, Maya. I had no idea you were there. You weren’t waiting on {i}us,{/i} were you?
lines.zh: 哦。嗨，Maya。我不知道你在那儿。你不是在等{i}我们{/i}吧？

lines.en: : I was just getting some fresh air, Ami.
lines.zh: 我只是出来透透气，Ami。

lines.en: : In the hallway? All the {i}fresh{/i} air is outside, silly goose.
lines.zh: 在走廊里？{i}新鲜{/i}的空气都在外面，小笨鹅。

lines.en: : My legs got tired.
lines.zh: 我腿酸了。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke3
: Ahh, okay. I feel you there. I’m {i}also{/i} really exhausted all of a sudden.
lines.zh: 啊，好吧。我懂你。我也{i}突然{/i}好累。

lines.en: : I wonder why?
lines.zh: 我在想是为什么呢？

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke4
: How are {i}you{/i} feeling, Sensei? We certainly {i}talked{/i} up a storm in there, didn’t we? I’m so glad we were able to figure out all of our family troubles together. I love you so much.
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}感觉怎么样，Sensei？我们刚才在里面可真是{i}聊{/i}得热火朝天，不是吗？真高兴我们能一起把家里那些破事都理清楚。我好爱你。

lines.en: : Helloooo? Sensei? I said I love you so much. This is the part where you tell me you love me too and then pat me on the head and call me a good girl.
lines.zh: 喂喂喂？Sensei？我说了我好爱你。这时候你该说你也爱我，然后拍拍我的头，说我是个好女孩。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke5
: Any reason you two have given up on talking all of a sudden? This is an afterparty, isn’t it? I’m pretty sure we’re {i}all{/i} supposed to be having fun. Not just me.
lines.zh: 你们两个怎么突然都不说话了？这可是余兴派对吧？我记得应该是{i}所有人{/i}都要开心才对。不只是我。

lines.en: : Are you having fun, Ami? Like, {i}really{/i} having fun?
lines.zh: 你开心吗，Ami？我是说，{i}真的{/i}开心吗？

lines.en: : What’s that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

lines.en: : Exactly what it sounds like it’s supposed to mean. I just want you to be happy.
lines.zh: 就是字面上的意思。我只是想让你幸福。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke6
: Aww! That’s so sweet of you! I’m having a great time. {i}Especially{/i} now that I’m all warm and fuzzy on the inside! Which I couldn’t have done without help from you guys, of course.
lines.zh: 哇！你好贴心！我玩得很开心。{i}尤其{/i}是现在心里暖乎乎、软绵绵的！当然，这少不了你们两位的帮忙。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke2
: So thanks again for leaving us alone. Or...mostly leaving us alone since you still wound up following us into the hall even though you knew this was a {i}private{/i} matter.
lines.zh: 所以再次谢谢你们让我们独处。或者……算是「基本」独处吧，因为你明知道这是{i}私事{/i}，最后还是跟到了走廊里。

lines.en: : Are you sad you weren’t invited?
lines.zh: 没被邀请，你难过吗？

lines.en: : Would {i}you{/i} have preferred to “have a talk” with Sensei in my place? Would {i}you{/i} have preferred to have him “help you carry stuff?”
lines.zh: 换作{i}你{/i}，是不是更想代替我「跟 Sensei 谈谈」？是不是更想让他「帮你搬东西」？

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke7
: Because it sure felt like he would have preferred you.
lines.zh: 因为看他那副样子，好像确实更希望你来。

lines.en: : Go back inside, Ami.
lines.zh: 回去，Ami。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke8
: Sensei! Round two already? You don’t even want to wait until we get home first? We’ve already been away for a while. What if the others get suspicious?
lines.zh: Sensei！这就第二轮了？你连回家都不想等？我们已经离开好一会儿了。万一别人起疑怎么办？

lines.en: : I want to talk to Maya.
lines.zh: 我想跟 Maya 谈谈。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke9
: Again? Was talking to me for half an hour not enough to satisfy your lecherous-
lines.zh: 又来？跟我谈了半小时还不够满足你那好色的-

lines.en: : You’re not Maya. I’m not falling for it again.
lines.zh: 你不是 Maya。我不会再上当了。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke10
: {i}Falling{/i} for it? You say that as if I {i}wanted{/i} to-
lines.zh: {i}上当{/i}？你这话说得，好像我{i}想{/i}-

lines.en: : Just go back inside. Ayane and Sana are waiting for you.
lines.zh: 回去吧。Ayane 和 Sana 在等你。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke11
: Fine.
lines.zh: 好。

lines.en: : {i}Talk to Maya.{/i} But don’t come crying back to me when she can’t give you what you want.
lines.zh: {i}跟 Maya 谈。{/i}不过等她给不了你想要的东西时，别回来哭着找我。

lines.en: : Or do. It won’t change anything about the way I feel.
lines.zh: 或者哭着回来也行。那不会改变我对你的感觉。

lines.en: : Besides, I have a creeping suspicion we’ll be spending a {i}lot{/i} more time together soon. And I guess it’s only fair you get to at least {i}explain{/i} to her what was going on in booth number three just now.
lines.zh: 再说，我有种越来越强的预感，我们很快就会{i}经常{/i}待在一起了。而且我觉得，你至少该向她{i}解释{/i}一下刚才在 3 号包厢里发生了什么，这才公平。

lines.en: : And spare no details, Sensei. Maya doesn’t like being lied to.
lines.zh: 别省略任何细节哦，Sensei。Maya 不喜欢被人骗。

lines.en: : None of us do.
lines.zh: 我们谁都不喜欢。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke12
: {i}Guuuuys! I’m back! Sorry for the- Ayane! This better be your only Despacito attempt!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}各——位！我回来了！抱歉，那个——Ayane！你最好只唱了这一次 Despacito！{/i}

lines.en: : Sit down.
lines.zh: 坐下。

lines.en: scene black
scene mayakaraoke13
There’s something about the way artificial light scatters that has always somewhat comforted me.
lines.zh: 人造光散射的方式里，总有某种让我感到安慰的东西。

lines.en: It isn’t like the sun. It cannot burn you, and chances are it’s never going to wake you up unless someone wants to piss you off.
lines.zh: 它不像太阳。它不会灼伤你，而且除非有人存心惹毛你，它大概永远不会把你叫醒。

lines.en: But it isn’t only that. It’s the adjustable glow. The fact you can make it stop whenever you want with the push of a button or the flick of a switch.
lines.zh: 但不止是这个。是那种可以调节的光晕。是你可以按一下按钮、拨一下开关，就让它随时停下。

lines.en: It’s the quiet hum. That half-rhythmic ambiance and its ability to shapeshift into a lullaby the moment you stop paying attention to everything else.
lines.zh: 是那安静的嗡鸣。那种半有节奏的氛围，以及当你的注意力从其他一切上移开时，它摇身一变成为一首摇篮曲的本事。

lines.en: I used to sleep with a nightlight on. I don’t know why I’m remembering that now.
lines.zh: 我小时候是开着夜灯睡觉的。我不知道自己为什么现在会想起这个。

lines.en: I have no idea why {i}that{/i} is what comes to mind in what could be the last moment I ever get to spend with this girl.
lines.zh: 我不知道为什么{i}这{/i}会是我在这可能是最后一次跟这个女孩相处的时刻里，想到的东西。

lines.en: I wonder if she knows.
lines.zh: 我想知道她是否知道。

lines.en: She probably doesn’t. She would have said something by now. {i}Warned{/i} me in some way. Made me drag a box across town for some reason I {i}still{/i} don’t know after all the times I’ve done this.
lines.zh: 她大概不知道。不然她早该说点什么了。用某种方式{i}警告{/i}过我了。让我拖着一个箱子穿过整座城，为了一个我做了这么多次{i}依然{/i}不知道的原因。

lines.en: I can’t figure out if it would be right to tell her. Or if she’d laugh at me for misunderstanding the weight of subconscious divinity while smirking and telling me the way {i}she{/i} thinks God would work.
lines.zh: 我不知道告诉她是否妥当。也不知道她会不会笑话我误解了潜意识神性的重量，然后一边坏笑一边告诉我{i}她{/i}心目中上帝的运作方式。

lines.en: The truth is though, we’re {i}both{/i} lost. It’s just easier to follow {i}her{/i} directions than mine because she’s had aeons to familiarize herself with these streets and walls and skies- and I’m just...
lines.zh: 但真相是，我们{i}两个{/i}都迷路了。只是听{i}她{/i}的指引比听我的更容易，因为她有无数岁月去熟悉这些街道、这些墙、这些天空——而我只是……

lines.en: I’m just listening to the soft hum of the vending machine.
lines.zh: 我只是听着自动售货机轻柔的嗡鸣。

lines.en: Basking in its subtle glow.
lines.zh: 沐浴在它微弱的光里。

lines.en: And wishing I could drag her down with me because having both of us wiped off the face of the earth sounds better than having to exist alone.
lines.zh: 然后希望我能把她一起拖下来，因为让我们俩从地球表面被一起抹掉，听起来总好过我独自存在。

lines.en: This moment of complacent sentience is the last I will ever have.
lines.zh: 这一刻自满的清醒，是我拥有的最后一刻。

lines.en: My time has run out.
lines.zh: 我的时间到了。

lines.en: And I’m not man enough to convince this world and those who have created it to let me stay.
lines.zh: 而我不够有担当，无法说服这个世界和创造它的人让我留下。

lines.en: I have one final message for you.
lines.zh: 我有最后一句话要给你。

lines.en: Yes, you. The one I can’t see but always think of.
lines.zh: 对，就是你。那个我看不见、却总会想起的人。

lines.en: Who keeps me company not out of love or lust, but obligation and curiosity.
lines.zh: 那个陪伴我、不是出于爱或欲望，而是出于义务与好奇的人。

lines.en: And that message is this-
lines.zh: 而那句话就是-

lines.en: I did all I could.
lines.zh: 我已经尽力了。

lines.en: It’s just really hard sometimes.
lines.zh: 只是有时候真的很难。

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: Maya-

lines.en: : Before you get all {i}sappy{/i} on me, I want you to understand that I didn’t realize until just a short while ago how “out of it” you are today.
lines.zh: 在你对我{i}煽情{/i}之前，我想让你明白，我是不久前才意识到你今天有多「不在状态」。

lines.en: : And that is on me for fooling myself into believing I’d be able to kick back and “relax” for a day. I have no idea how Ayane does it.
lines.zh: 而这是我自作自受，居然傻到以为自己可以放松「休息」一整天。我不知道 Ayane 是怎么做到的。

lines.en: : This hasn’t been easy for her. I’d wager she’s fighting back a crisis at this very moment.
lines.zh: 这对她来说并不轻松。我敢说她此刻正在强压着一场危机。

lines.en: : She is. I can feel it. That...burning desire to have {i}something{/i} go right. Which is why I imagine she invited Sana.
lines.zh: 她在压。我能感觉到。那种渴望{i}某件事{/i}能顺利的、灼热的欲望。所以我想她才会邀请 Sana。

lines.en: : I’ve learned she’s like a...teddy bear to Ayane or something. She makes her feel {i}comfortable.{/i}
lines.zh: 我发现 Sana 对 Ayane 来说大概像是……一只泰迪熊之类的。她让她觉得{i}安心{/i}。

lines.en: : But {i}she’s{/i} been acting rather “out of it” as well. Combine that with {i}Ami{/i} being stuck on high alert and it turns this entire afterparty into an insufferable nightmare.
lines.zh: 但{i}她{/i}表现得也挺「不在状态」。再加上{i}Ami{/i}一直处于高度警戒，整个余兴派对就变成了一场令人难以忍受的噩梦。

lines.en: : Why is Ami on high alert?
lines.zh: Ami 为什么处于高度警戒？

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke14
: Oh, I don’t know. Maybe because you somehow mistook her for {i}me{/i} this morning and made it sound like we’re secretly together?
lines.zh: 哦，我不知道。也许是因为你今早不知怎么把她错认成了{i}我{/i}，还说得好像我们偷偷在一起了？

lines.en: : I mean...in a really roundabout way-
lines.zh: 我的意思是……绕了很大一圈的话-

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke15
: No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: : We’re not.
lines.zh: 我们不是。

lines.en: : We {i}can’t{/i} be. Not even in a “really roundabout way.” I told you this already and the fact that you’re ignoring it is not only decidedly moronic but {i}extremely{/i} insensitive. So, again, please stop.
lines.zh: 我们{i}不可能{/i}是。哪怕是「绕了很大一圈」也不是。我已经跟你说过了，你无视这一点不仅蠢得可以，而且{i}极其{/i}不体贴。所以，再说一次，请停下。

lines.en: : Maya, if I get sent back to the beginning again before {i}anything{/i} happens between us, it’s going to fucking suck.
lines.zh: Maya，如果在我们之间{i}发生任何事{/i}之前我就被送回起点，那可他妈太糟了。

lines.en: : And I can’t imagine {i}you’ll{/i} be very happy having to wait another billion years or whatever it was to see me again.
lines.zh: 而且我想{i}你{/i}也不会太高兴，要再等上十亿年什么的才能再见到我。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke16
: Yeah, that {i}would{/i} fucking suck. But what sucks even more is not knowing if I {i}would{/i} see you again. For all we know, this could be some kind of fluke.
lines.zh: 是啊，那{i}确实{/i}糟透了。但更糟的是，我不知道自己{i}会不会{/i}再见到你。在我们看来，这可能只是一次意外。

lines.en: : Or a miracle.
lines.zh: 或者一个奇迹。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke17
: Since when do {i}you{/i} believe in miracles?
lines.zh: 从什么时候起{i}你{/i}开始相信奇迹了？

lines.en: : Since I met you.
lines.zh: 从我遇见你开始。

lines.en: : Aw, cute. Did you expect me to swoon and fall into your arms after dropping that line? Or would you like to return to earth for a moment and level with me {i}without{/i} sounding like the lead in a K-drama?
lines.zh: 哎呀，好可爱。说完这句，你是期待我晕倒在你怀里吗？还是说你愿意回到地球上，{i}别{/i}像韩剧男主那样说话，好好跟我说？

lines.en: : Hey, you’re lucky I’m managing to hold a normal conversation at all right now. I’ve barely been able to do that since I woke up.
lines.zh: 嘿，你能听到我现在还能正常对话就该庆幸了。我从醒来之后就几乎做不到这个。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke18
: Yeah...and that is...{i}concerning{/i} for a number of reasons, but I’m having trouble coming to grips with exactly {i}why{/i} since I feel...fine.
lines.zh: 嗯……那确实……有{i}若干理由{/i}让人担忧，可我很难搞清楚{i}为什么{/i}要担忧，因为我觉得……挺好的。

lines.en: : I feel {i}normal.{/i} But the way everyone else is acting right now is starting to make me feel like we’re coming up on another reset. And if that’s the case, how did it sneak by me? I’m the...girl who knows stuff.
lines.zh: 我觉得{i}很正常{/i}。但其他人现在的表现，开始让我觉得我们又要迎来一次重置了。如果是这样，它是怎么瞒过我的？我可是那个……知道很多事的女孩。

lines.en: : Cool nickname.
lines.zh: 这外号挺酷。

lines.en: : It’s a work in progress.
lines.zh: 还在打磨中。

lines.en: : If this is a reset...I don’t think it’s a normal one.
lines.zh: 如果这是重置……我觉得它不是一次普通的重置。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke19
: What makes you say that?
lines.zh: 你为什么这么说？

lines.en: : Well...without beating around the bush, I’ve been plagued by mild to severe hallucinations about how the seasons are changing and that I’m going to be punished for not doing what I’ve been told.
lines.zh: 嗯……就不绕弯子了，我一直被轻度到重度的幻觉困扰，说季节在变换、说我要因为没照吩咐去做而受罚。

lines.en: : I’m confused. Isn’t that just a Tuesday for you?
lines.zh: 我糊涂了。对你来说那不就是家常便饭吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but how do {i}you{/i} know that?
lines.zh: 是啊，可{i}你{/i}是怎么知道的？

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke20
: How the fuck do you {i}think{/i} I know that? You {i}do{/i} realize we were a {i}little{/i} more than just shuffleboard partners before this all started happening, right?
lines.zh: 你觉得我{i}他妈{/i}是怎么知道的？你{i}应该{/i}意识到，在这一切开始之前，我们可{i}不止{/i}是打沙狐球的搭档吧？

lines.en: : This has been happening all along? It’s not just a...weird loop-world thing?
lines.zh: 这一直都在发生？不只是……某种诡异的循环世界之类的东西？

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke21
: It’s not new at all.
lines.zh: 一点也不新鲜。

lines.en: : You’ve been a pathetic husk of a man since I met you. And those “hallucinations” of yours have been telling you things like that for years and years and years.
lines.zh: 从我认识你起，你就是个可悲的空壳男人。而你那些「幻觉」告诉你这种话，已经说了好多年好多年好多年了。

lines.en: : But they’re all just in your head. None of it’s real. And, as far as I know, they’ve never been right before. I see no reason to start believing them now.
lines.zh: 但它们全都在你脑子里。没有一个是真的。而且据我所知，它们以前从没说对过。我看不出有什么理由现在开始相信它们。

lines.en: : The timing just...feels wrong, don’t you think?
lines.zh: 只是时机……感觉不对，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : The timing of everything feels wrong pretty much all the time when you’re perpetually stuck in the body of a teenage girl. But you get used to it after a while.
lines.zh: 当你永远被困在一个青春期女孩的身体里，什么事的时机都几乎总是感觉不对。不过过一阵子你就习惯了。

lines.en: : Like I’m sure {i}you’ve{/i} mostly gotten used to your weird black-outs that, on some occasions, cause you to throw yourself on top of unsuspecting girls.
lines.zh: 就像{i}你{/i}大概也已经基本习惯了那些诡异的断片，有时候还会让你扑到毫无防备的女孩身上。

lines.en: : That never happened with you, did it?
lines.zh: 那事从来没发生在你身上吧？

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke22
: Oh, all the time.
lines.zh: 哦，经常发生。

lines.en: : It was extremely confusing at first, but I actually started to like it after a while. It kept me on my toes and gave you a {i}major{/i} increase in stamina.
lines.zh: 一开始非常令人困惑，但过了一阵子我还真有点喜欢上了。它让我时刻保持警觉，还让你的耐力{i}大幅{/i}提升。

lines.en: : I think that’s the closest you’ve ever come to hitting on me.
lines.zh: 我觉得这是你最接近跟我调情的一次了。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke23
: Laid-back Maya is more inclined to say things like this as she’s wasting less of her brain-space worrying about the end of the world while, apparently, everyone else worries about it even more.
lines.zh: 放松版 Maya 更愿意说这种话，因为她浪费在担心世界末日上的脑容量更少，而显然其他人担心得更多。

lines.en: : If by “everyone else” you just mean me, you’re probably right.
lines.zh: 如果你说的「其他人」只是指我，那你大概是对的。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke24
: Do you really think anyone else’s thoughts actually matter to me?
lines.zh: 你觉得别人的想法真的重要到我会在意吗？

lines.en: : No. But I was under the impression mine didn’t either.
lines.zh: 不重要。但我以为我的也不重要。

lines.en: : They don’t. But they’re {i}closer{/i} to mattering and I think that’s what really counts at the end of the day.
lines.zh: 是不重要。但它们{i}比较{/i}接近重要，我觉得说到底，这才真正算数。

lines.en: : Then, if my thoughts are “closer to mattering,” shouldn’t Laid-back Maya maybe warn Normal Maya that Ami isn’t the only person who should be on some type of “high-alert” right now?
lines.zh: 那么，如果我的想法「比较接近重要」，放松版 Maya 是不是该提醒一下正常版 Maya：现在该处于某种「高度警戒」的，可不止 Ami 一个人？

lines.en: : I’m keeping an eye out. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: 我盯着呢。别担心。

lines.en: : I know it’s coming soon. We’re just not there {i}yet.{/i} And I don’t want to waste the {i}one{/i} night I have dedicated to not being an overbearing know-it-all on being a...well, an overbearing know-it-all.
lines.zh: 我知道它快来了。我们只是还{i}没到{/i}那一步。而且我不想把我{i}唯一{/i}一个专门用来「不当个爱管闲事的万事通」的晚上，浪费在……嗯，当个爱管闲事的万事通上。

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah, if anyone knows when it will be coming, it’s you. I’m probably just...over-thinking things.
lines.zh: 是啊……是啊，要说谁知道它什么时候来，那就是你了。我大概只是……想太多了。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke25

: Yeah, I could {i}really{/i} tell your brain was firing on all cylinders a few minutes ago when I saw you having sex with a girl pretending to be me. Pretty intense case of “over-thinking” if I don’t say so myself.
lines.zh: 是啊，几分钟前我看到你跟一个假装是我的女孩做爱的时候，可真能看出你的脑子在全力运转。要我说，这{i}想太多{/i}的病例还挺严重的。

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: Maya-

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke26

: Don’t worry. You don’t need to {i}apologize{/i} or whatever it is you’re thinking of doing right now. Laid-back Maya will not fault you for boning your niece. You’re free to be as creepy as you want.
lines.zh: 别担心。你不需要{i}道歉{/i}或者你现在脑子里想做的随便什么。放松版 Maya 不会因为 you 跟自己侄女上床而怪你。你想多变态就多变态吧。

lines.en: : Laid-back Maya is...disturbingly accepting of incest.
lines.zh: 放松版 Maya 对乱伦的接受度……高得令人不安。

lines.en: : She probably heard from Normal Maya about a bunch of stuff that was {i}way{/i} creepier and {i}way{/i} more fucked up. This was nothing by comparison.
lines.zh: 她大概从正常版 Maya 那儿听说了不少{i}更{/i}恶心、{i}更{/i}变态的事。相比之下这根本不算什么。

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke27
: If anything, I might even say I’m flattered. You’re so desperate to have sex with me that you tricked yourself into believing you {i}were.{/i} Even when I lose, I win.
lines.zh: 要说的话，我甚至可能觉得受宠若惊。你这么想跟我上床，以至于骗自己相信那个{i}就是{/i}我。就算我输了，我也赢了。

lines.en: : Just not all of the times when I’m actually losing. Which is a lot.
lines.zh: 除了那些我真的在输的时候。而那种时候还挺多的。

lines.en: : You’re really not even a little disturbed by this?
lines.zh: 你真的一点都不觉得别扭？

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke28
: Disturbed? Not really.
lines.zh: 别扭？倒也不。

lines.en: : The sting of seeing you sleep with all of my friends stopped hurting as much a long time ago. Now, it just makes me feel lonely and nostalgic.
lines.zh: 看着你跟我所有朋友上床的那种刺痛，很久以前就不那么疼了。现在，它只会让我觉得孤独和怀旧。

lines.en: : But maybe that’s just something I started believing to protect myself.
lines.zh: 但也许那只是我开始相信、用来保护自己的说法。

lines.en: : Either way, I’ll take solace in the fact that you {i}wanted{/i} it to be me. And completely ignore the fact that Ami is your niece because pretty much no one ever cares about that when they wake up here.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我会从「你{i}希望{/i}那是我」这件事里得到安慰。并且完全无视 Ami 是你侄女这个事实，因为在这儿醒来的人，几乎没人在乎这个。

lines.en: : What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that pretty much all of the other {i}Senseis{/i} sleep with her in their first week here.
lines.zh: 我是说，几乎所有其他的{i}Sensei{/i}在来到这儿的头一周都会跟她上床。

lines.en: : Does that make you uncomfortable? Thinking of your beloved niece crumbling under the touch of anyone that isn’t you?
lines.zh: 这让你不舒服了吗？想到你心爱的侄女在不是你的人的触碰下崩塌？

lines.en: : I...I don’t really know how to feel about that.
lines.zh: 我……我真的不知道该作何感想。

lines.en: : It’s okay to hate it. I know you love her. And I know firsthand how much even the thought of that can get to a person.
lines.zh: 恨这种感觉也没关系。我知道你爱她。而且我亲身知道，光是想想就能对一个人造成多大的影响。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for everything I’ve put you through, Maya.
lines.zh: 我很抱歉让你经历了这一切，Maya。

lines.en: : Don’t be. I’d take that discomfort a trillion times over if it means keeping you here.
lines.zh: 别这样。如果能把你留在这儿，那种不适我愿意承受一万亿次。

lines.en: : It just kind of blows that my only choices are “Watch you have sex with a girl pretending to be me” and “Never see you again.”
lines.zh: 只是有点操蛋：我仅有的选项是「看着你跟一个假装是我的女孩上床」和「再也见不到你」。

lines.en: : There’s a third, you know.
lines.zh: 还有第三个，你知道的。

lines.en: : What is it? Risk everything to have sex with you and then potentially never see you again? Because the Ami option still sounds a little more appealing to me thanks to that caveat at the end there.
lines.zh: 是什么？赌上一切跟你上床，然后可能再也见不到你？因为那个「再也见不到」的附加条件，Ami 那个选项对我来说还是稍微更有吸引力一点。

lines.en: : I think it’s worth it.
lines.zh: 我觉得值得。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you also convinced yourself the world was about to end a few minutes ago and now you’re trying to seduce me. But that’s okay. You’ve never been very good at {i}thinking.{/i}
lines.zh: 是啊，可你几分钟前还让自己相信世界要完蛋了，现在又来勾引我。不过没关系。你从来就不太擅长{i}思考{/i}。

lines.en: : I hope you’re right, Maya.
lines.zh: 我希望你是对的，Maya。

lines.en: : Me too.
lines.zh: 我也是。

lines.en: : Because, if I’m not...
lines.zh: 因为，如果我没说对……

lines.en: : Things could get very ugly.
lines.zh: 事情可能会变得非常难看。

: Hey...

lines.en: scene mayakaraoke32
: You...
: You...should...
lines.zh: 你……应该……

lines.en: : You should...say that thing again...
lines.zh: 你……应该……再说一遍那句话……

lines.en: : The...thing you said to me on the beach.
lines.zh: 就是……你在海滩上对我说的那句话。

lines.en: : That’s not a confession, though. It’s not me...saying anything.
lines.zh: 不过那不算表白。那不是我……在说什么。

lines.en: : You don’t have to.
lines.zh: 你不需要。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m in love with you, Maya Makinami.
lines.zh: 我爱你，Maya Makinami。
